title: Edge-Local Spectral Information and Size-Dependent Scaling in Edge-Size-Weighted Nonuniform Hypergraph Tensors
author: Wanzheng Ning
summary: The current manuscript draft examines local combinatorial information in a size-homogeneous weighted nonuniform hypergraph adjacency tensor. It develops a neighbor-profile spectral bound and studies edge-local separation, equality, quotient reduction, and loose-star scaling within that tensor model.
